scope: free-running generation failures on the immutable v1+v3 suites (15 tasks/subject), instrumented by workstream A

definitions.invalid_token_direct: a single emitted token makes an incrementally-valid prefix parse-invalid and the error persists to the end of the output
definitions.structural_inconsistency: the persisting parser error was inherited from an earlier prefix (not introduced by the newest token)
definitions.incomplete_only_never_invalid: no prefix is ever hard-invalid; the output is open-state at stop (premature stop / truncation)

categories.incorrect_indentation: emitted token starts an indentation transition the parser rejects (dominant direct class)
categories.premature_stop_open_construct: generation stopped while the program was still syntactically open
categories.other_parser_confirmed_syntax_error: parser-confirmed syntax error not better classified above

stage_comparison.stage12: first-invalid-token analysis: 43/45 task-subject rows are directly-introduced persistent syntax defects, dominated by indentation transitions; 2/45 (dense control) are premature stops
